LZMA SDK (7-Zip source code, C folder)

Version 26.06, https://github.com/ip7z/7zip commit d3296e39e1f1f92c7b41c0c3848e65640428d42d,
files unchanged but for trailing whitespace.
Only the 7z, LZMA, LZMA2, BCJ, BCJ2, ARM and delta decoders and the headers they include are kept here.

Igor Pavlov : Public domain

Each file in this folder states "Igor Pavlov : Public domain" in its header. The LZMA SDK is placed in the public domain:
anyone is free to copy, modify, publish, use, compile, sell, or distribute it, either in source code form or as a compiled
binary, for any purpose, commercial or non-commercial, and by any means.
